name: Betta Comments
author: Willard Muzaeni

sections.description:
Betta Comments is a comprehensive solution for WordPress administrators to efficiently manage comments and reviews. This plugin enhances the native WordPress comment management features by allowing administrators to bulk delete comments and reviews, apply advanced filters, and ensure that comment management is streamlined and secure.

Key Features:
* Bulk delete comments and reviews.
* Filter comments/reviews by status (approved, pending, spam, trash).
* Select specific comments/reviews for deletion.
* Clear confirmation dialog before deleting multiple items.
* Enhanced security measures to prevent accidental mass deletions.
* User-friendly interface with intuitive controls and progress indicators.

Additional Features:
* Delete comments/reviews based on date range or author.
* Integration with existing WordPress comment/review management tools.

This plugin is essential for any WordPress site with a high volume of comments or reviews, ensuring that comment management is as efficient and secure as possible.

Features

  • Efficient management of large comment volumes with pagination
  • Customizable entries per page (25, 50, or 100)
  • Quick access from plugin page with direct navigation link
  • Comprehensive filtering options for comments and reviews
  • Bulk delete functionality with confirmation safeguards
  • User-friendly interface with intuitive controls
  • Visual comment count indicator in admin menu
  • Compatible with both comments and reviews
  • Secure implementation following WordPress best practices
sections.faq:
How do I use Betta Comments?

Once installed and activated, Betta Comments adds a new menu item under the “Comments” section in your WordPress admin dashboard. From there, you can bulk delete, filter, and manage your comments and reviews.

Does Betta Comments work with WooCommerce reviews?

Yes, Betta Comments is fully compatible with WooCommerce reviews, allowing you to filter and delete product reviews just like regular comments.

Is there a way to restore deleted comments?

As of version 1.1.0, Betta Comments does not include a comment restoration feature. Deleted comments are moved to the trash, where they can be permanently deleted after 24 hours.= How many comments can I manage at once? =
You can choose to display 25, 50, or 100 comments per page. The pagination feature allows you to easily navigate through all your comments, regardless of the total number.

Can I filter comments by author?

Yes, you can filter comments by author name or email address. The filtering system has been improved for better accuracy in version 1.2.0.

Is it possible to bulk delete comments?

Yes, you can select multiple comments and delete them in bulk. The plugin includes a confirmation dialog to prevent accidental deletions.

Where can I find the plugin in the admin menu?

The plugin appears as “Betta Comments” in the main admin menu, located between Pages and Posts for easy access.

Plugin Navigation

  • The plugin menu can now be found directly in the WordPress admin menu (between Pages and Posts)
  • Quick access to plugin settings via the ‘Access’ link in the Plugins page
  • Support the plugin by leaving a review via the new ‘Leave a Review’ link

For more information, visit WordPress.
